title: mimi-mls: a refused Welcome join still consumes a one-time KeyPackage
description: Found during krmn K2 (mimid-krmn.2). OpenMLS deletes the one-time KeyPackage while building the StagedWelcome (openmls fork group/mls_group/creation.rs ~706-713), before any mimid check (required components, decision mimid-krmn.6 rule 4; other join refusals) runs. A refused join therefore burns a KeyPackage the client then has to replace. Pre-existing for every refused Welcome join. Options to evaluate: re-store the KeyPackage on refusal (if OpenMLS exposes it), check what can be checked before staging, or document as a Limitation and let the agent upload a replacement. Not urgent: affects only refused joins.
notes: 2026-11-04: fork change done in /home/mark/GIT/openmls working tree (uncommitted; patch scratchpad/fork-473.patch): delete moved from keys_for_welcome to StagedWelcome::into_group after store; VC retained material likewise; book + rustdoc updated; fork test welcome_consumes_key_package_only_on_join (failed first); full cargo test -p openmls ok. mimid test join_welcome_refusal_keeps_the_key_package failed first (NoMatchingKeyPackage) and passes against the fork; Limitations updated. Awaiting Mark's OK: fork commit + push, bump all 7 [patch.crates-io] revs, mimid commit. Choice made: delete failure after store returns StorageError (group already stored) rather than allowing reuse.
